description: This file defines the CatalogItem class, representing a product or item in the catalog with properties such as name, description, price, picture URI, and related type and brand identifiers. It includes methods to update item details, brand, type, and picture URI, and defines an internal record struct for item details.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a catalog item with properties like name, description, price, picture URI, and associated type/brand IDs. It supports updates to these properties with validation.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing catalog item properties with provided values.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates name, description, and price with validation using guard clauses.

methods.name: UpdateBrand
methods.description: Updates the catalog brand ID after validating it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdateType
methods.description: Updates the catalog type ID after validating it is not zero.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Updates the picture URI with a provided filename, or clears it if the filename is null or empty.
